messages.subject: save and restore node layout positions
messages.subject_clean: save and restore node layout positions
messages.body_plain:
Saving, and then restoring, the positions of nodes in a network is
easy to do with RCy.   It is explained at the website:

    browse to rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net <http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net>
    click on 'examples' in the uppler left frame
    click on 'save & restore node layout' in the lower left frame

or go directly to

 http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net/versions/current/cookbook/positions.html

Please let me know if the example and explanation need improvment.

Cheers,

 - Paul

messages.subject: use RCytoscape to put custom graphics on nodes
messages.subject_clean: use RCytoscape to put custom graphics on nodes
messages.body_plain:
I have added a 'recipe' to the RCytoscape website which explains,
first in overview, then in detail, how to render nodes in Cytoscape
from custom graphics image files.

Since data-driven graphics are easily created in R, and since RCy
makes it easy to place these images on nodes in Cytoscape, this
capability may be of interest to some.

The recipe (with working code) can be found at

   http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net

Click on 'examples' then
   'Informational' nodes: plots, legends

or browse straight to

http://rcytoscape.systemsbiology.net/versions/current/cookbook/infoNodes/index.html

Suggestions and critique are most welcome.

Cheers,

 - Paul
